# PlaySuite paper generator

`paper.cpp` and `paper.hpp` are copied without modification from
`falseywinchnet/games`, `shared/paper/src/`, commit
`c5ea5a658c99042d4eed0aa800e910abadd9e131`.

The upstream license is preserved in `LICENSE` and distributed as
`packaging/licenses/PlaySuite-paper-LICENSE.txt`. Plan Paint's adapter is
`src/sticky_note.cpp`. Build this source with C++20, double-precision arithmetic,
floating-point contraction disabled and no fast-math.
